note: Triennial election of the rural district council, 1933: nominations received by W. Calvert, clerk, 25 April 1933. The Armagh Guardian list has no entry for Richhill and includes a "Keady—Thomas Mallon, J.P. (N.)" line that appears to belong to the county council list, so neither is filed here. Polled 25 May 1933. Redman stood for the Farmers' Defence Association and was identified with the Fruit Growers' Association; Dunlop was the retiring member and chairman of the Guardians.
